basic_profile.bio: Originally from Seattle, I moved to San Francisco for a job in graphic design about two years ago. I'm a huge fan of the surreal and love incorporating elements of it into my work. Outside of work, I'm deeply interested in spiritual exploration, often diving into books and communities that discuss philosophical and existential topics. I'm a night owl and usually online during late evenings. I currently work for a small design firm and am in a long-term relationship with my partner, who shares my interest in unconventional art and spirituality.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Graphic Design and have been working in the field for over five years. My interest in spirituality and philosophy is largely self-taught, stemming from a personal quest to understand the deeper meaning of life. This is reflected in my active participation in discussion threads about spiritual and philosophical topics.
